title: Putnami Doctor Report or Waiver File
description: The two doctor wire shapes: a Report of production-readiness findings evaluated under a profile, and the committed doctor.waivers.json WaiverFile of accepted findings. A document is exactly one of the two.

severity.description: How urgent a finding is. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.

profile.description: A deployment profile. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.

checkCode.description: One class of doctor finding. The taxonomy is frozen: renaming, repurposing, or removing a code requires a protocol version bump; adding one is additive and does not, since documents written against an earlier vocabulary stay valid.

evidence.description: Where to look for a finding: a path and/or a field name only. Deliberately has no slot for a resolved value.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the file that produced the finding.

field.description: Configuration path or field name; a name, never a resolved value.

waiverProvenance.description: Records that a finding was suppressed by a matching committed waiver.

expires.description: RFC 3339 date the waiver lapses. Opaque data; never evaluated by the protocol package.

summary.description: Finding tallies; the per-severity counts sum to findings and waived counts findings with waivedBy provenance.

report.description: The result of one `putnami doctor` evaluation for a single profile.

waiver.description: One accepted finding. Matches by code and, when project is set, by project; an empty project applies workspace-wide. When field is set, the waiver narrows to the single finding whose evidence field matches, instead of every finding of its code.

field.description: Optional config path or field name; narrows the waiver to the single matching finding. A name, never a resolved value.

expires.description: RFC 3339 date the waiver lapses. Opaque data; never evaluated by the protocol package.
